info.title: Airport Retail Media Platform API
info.description: REST API of the airport retail media platform: simulation control, live operations, the ad decision engine (with its evidence trail), master data, and the passenger claim flow. Live updates are streamed as Server-Sent Events from `GET /api/stream?topics=…` (topics: clock, flight, flights_reloaded, queue, screen, incident, feeds, sim, decisions, delivery, presence, model, catalog, claims).
